starts.name: The JunkHub (Unique ship with upgrade mechanic)
starts.desc:
There is a legend of unique hubship built by greatest minds and lost in their hubris. It is said to be filled with potential beyond most reason and bring blessings on its captain. But legend is legend for reason, as no one has seen ship stories talk about for over a hundred cycles. Or at least until recently, as a grandiose hull made its way through multiple junkyards (under your watchful gaze), collecting parts and making it spaceworthy again.

You have managed to unearth the wreckage of The Grand Chungus, spending all your savings and selling most of your fleet to repair the hull and bring it online as your own flagship. 

Special: Restore and upgrade The Grand Chungus, one step at a time, at any friendly dockyard. There are multiple upgrade paths to choose from!
